verdict.rationale: Gemini in BigQuery is a documented built-in assistant. Users can ask it to generate, complete or explain SQL and Python. Conversational analytics lets them talk to their data in natural language, and data canvas uses natural language to find, join and query tables and visualize results. Data insights automatically generates analysis queries from table metadata. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution beyond code generation and answering questions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well delegation works in practice.
